Open the Quality Manager desk directly from the admin dashboard. This will launch the QM login screen and bring you to QM Desk functions.

Hallmark Price Settings

Admin-only control for future BIS tariff revisions. Earlier invoices remain linked to the rate applicable on their invoice date.

Add New BIS Revised Rate

Choose the official effective date. The portal will apply this rate only to invoices dated on or after that date.

Note: Saving a rate may recalculate invoices dated on or after its effective date.
